definitions.gloss: social conditions; state of the world; state of society
definitions.explanation: The general atmosphere, trends, and conditions of society at a given time. Encompasses economic conditions, public sentiment, cultural trends, and the overall mood of an era.

examples.japanese: {世相|せそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}する→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧。
examples.english: To reflect the state of society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世相|せそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{表|あらわ}している→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: This year's kanji captures the state of society well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世相|せそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Through novels, you can learn about the social conditions of the time.

notes:
Refers to the overall state of society at a particular point in time — its mood, trends, and conditions. Often used when discussing how art, media, or cultural events capture or reflect the spirit of an era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世相|せそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}する→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧: to reflect the state of society
- {世相|せそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{映|うつ}す→映す：12963_utsusu⟧: to mirror social conditions
- {世相|せそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to represent the state of the world
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{世相|せそう}: contemporary social conditions
- ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧{世相|せそう}: grim state of the world

USAGE:
Commonly appears in media commentary, literary criticism, and year-end reflections. Japan's annual '⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧' (kanji of the year) event explicitly aims to capture the {世相|せそう} of that year in a single character.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世情|せじょう}: the ways of the world, social conditions (more literary)
- {時勢|じせい}: the times, current trends (emphasizes temporal trends)
- ⟦{風潮|ふうちょう}→風潮：05780_fuuchou⟧: trend, tendency (focuses on a particular social movement or direction)
